simp_chinese: 圣皮埃尔湖是圣劳伦斯河在索雷尔与三河城之间形成的一片宽阔浅水面，接近河流向河口过渡的地带。沼泽、岛屿与泛洪岸地为捕鱼、狩猎和迁徙水鸟提供了丰富环境，河流则让旅人穿湖而过。阿贝纳基人称它为内贝塞克。雅克·卡蒂埃在1535年航行时称它为昂古莱姆；萨缪尔·德·尚普兰于1603年6月29日经过后，按当天的圣徒节日将它命名为圣皮埃尔。湖泊的历史也属于它的岸边：聚落、渡船和冬季冰路将周围社群与水面联系起来。开阔的湖面有利于通行，春季洪水、破裂的冰层和突起的风暴却使这段貌似平静的水路充满危险。

english: Lake Sakami belongs to the Cree country inland from eastern James Bay. In the wider Chisasibi region, Cree families long moved between seasonal places before fur-trade posts helped establish more permanent settlements.
simp_chinese: 萨卡米湖属于詹姆斯湾东部向内陆延伸的克里人地区。在更广阔的奇萨西比地区，克里家庭长期在季节性营地之间移动，后来毛皮贸易站推动了较固定聚落的形成。

english: Lake Sandal belongs to Olonets Karelia, the southern portion of East Karelia. The wider region lies between Ladoga Karelia, White Karelia, the Svir and Lake Onega. Its inhabitants preserve Livvi Karelian, a distinct regional form of the Karelian language.
simp_chinese: 桑达尔湖属于东卡累利阿南部的奥洛涅茨卡累利阿。广义地区位于拉多加卡累利阿、白卡累利阿、斯维里河与奥涅加湖之间。当地居民保存利维卡累利阿语这一独特地区语言形式。

english: Sangiin Dalai is a salt lake in northern Mongolia. Mountains, hills and rocky ground surround its basin, near the region struck by the great Bolnai earthquake of 1905.
simp_chinese: 桑根达来湖是蒙古北部的咸水湖。湖盆周围有山脉、丘陵与岩地，邻近1905年博尔奈大地震发生的地区。

english: Lake Sarisu belongs to the Kura lowland setting associated with Shirvan. The wider historical region stretches between the Kura River and the western Caspian shore, centred on the Shirvan Plain.
simp_chinese: 萨里苏湖属于与希尔凡相联系的库拉河低地地带。更广阔的历史地区延展于库拉河与里海西岸之间，以希尔凡平原为中心。

english: Sartlan occupies a closed basin in the Baraba steppe of western Siberia. Its slightly saline waters cover a broad but shallow lake, averaging about three metres deep. Other lakes, including Malye Chany and Uryum, form part of the surrounding steppe-water landscape.
simp_chinese: 萨尔特兰湖位于西西伯利亚巴拉巴草原的闭流盆地。微咸湖水覆盖宽广浅湖，平均深度约三米。周边还有小恰内湖和乌留姆湖等，构成草原与湖泊交错的景观。

english: Lake Sasyk-Syvash belongs to the salt-lake country of southwestern Crimea. It is the largest of more than fifty salt lakes and salt pans across the peninsula. These waters form part of a broader landscape in which shallow lakes can gradually become salt flats.
simp_chinese: 萨瑟克‑瑟瓦什湖属于克里米亚西南盐湖地区。它是半岛五十多个盐湖与盐沼中最大者。这些水域属于更广阔景观的一部分，浅湖可能逐渐转变为盐滩。

english: Lake Seletsy belongs to the Karelian lake country. The wider region extends from the White Sea toward the Gulf of Finland and includes Europe’s two largest lakes, Ladoga and Onega.
simp_chinese: 谢列齐湖属于卡累利阿湖泊地区。广义卡累利阿从白海延伸向芬兰湾，包括欧洲最大的两座湖泊拉多加湖与奥涅加湖。

english:
Seliger is a chain of lake basins joined by narrow channels in the northwestern Valdai Hills. Forests fringe its shores and numerous islands divide the water, creating a landscape very different from a single open lake. Covering about 212 square kilometers, the system lies within the wider Volga basin.

Only the Selizharovka carries water out of Seliger, leaving at the southern end and reaching the Volga after some 36 kilometers. Ostashkov is the lake's sole town, while the Nilo-Stolobensky Monastery occupies Stolobny Island. The monastery and the wooded islands give the lake both a religious landmark and a sheltered inland-water setting.
simp_chinese:
谢利格尔湖位于瓦尔代丘陵西北部，由一系列通过狭窄水道相连的湖盆构成。森林环绕湖岸，众多岛屿分隔水面，使这里呈现出与单一开阔湖泊十分不同的景观。整套湖泊系统面积约212平方公里，属于更大的伏尔加河流域。

谢利扎罗夫卡河是唯一的出水河道，从湖南端流出，约36公里后注入伏尔加河。奥斯塔什科夫是湖畔唯一的城镇，尼洛—斯托洛本斯基修道院则坐落于斯托洛布内岛上。修道院与林木覆盖的岛屿，共同构成了这片内陆水域的宗教地标与幽静景致。

english:
Lake Sentarum is a changing waterscape within the upper Kapuas basin, deep in the interior of Borneo. It belongs to a vast floodplain containing about twenty seasonal lakes, interspersed with freshwater swamp and peat-swamp forest. Local people call such country lebak lebung, the floodplain. Here the outline of a lake is inseparable from the rise and fall of river water.

The lakes support a substantial traditional fishery, and Malay fishing communities inhabit much of the western floodplain. Asian arowana and clown loaches are among the many fish in these waters, while the forests shelter proboscis monkeys, orangutans and great argus pheasants. The modern national park designation dates to 1999; the alternating water, forest and fishing settlements belong to the older landscape that it protects.
simp_chinese:
森塔伦湖位于婆罗洲腹地的卡普阿斯河上游盆地，是一片随水位变化的湖泽景观。广阔洪泛平原上分布着约二十座季节性湖泊，其间交错着淡水沼泽林和泥炭沼泽林。当地人将这种地貌称为“勒巴克勒邦”，即洪泛平原。在这里，湖泊的轮廓与河水涨落密不可分。

湖群支撑着规模可观的传统渔业，西部洪泛区生活着许多马来渔民社群。亚洲龙鱼和小丑泥鳅是这里丰富鱼类中的两种，林地还栖息着长鼻猴、猩猩与大眼斑雉。现代国家公园设立于1999年；它所保护的，是由水域、森林和渔村共同组成的更早景观。

english: Lake Sergozero belongs to the White Sea drainage of the southern Kola Peninsula. Its outflow, the Serga, runs thirty-eight kilometres before joining the Varzuga, linking the lake to one of the peninsula’s principal southward river systems.
simp_chinese: 谢尔戈泽罗湖属于科拉半岛南部的白海水系。出流谢尔加河流经三十八公里后注入瓦尔祖加河，将湖泊同半岛一条主要南流水系联系起来。

english: Lake Sevan fills a high basin of the Armenian uplands, fed by numerous streams and drained by the Hrazdan. Before modern engineering lowered its waters, it lay at roughly 1,916 metres above the sea and contained a large island bearing the monastery of Sevanavank. Medieval Armenian writers knew the lake as the Sea of Gegham; classical authors called it Lychnitis, while later Turkic usage gave it the name Gokcha, the blue lake. Together with Van and Urmia it was counted among the great seas of historic Armenia. Travellers noticed both its religious houses and its fisheries. In 1673 Jean Chardin described its fresh water, island monastery and fish supplied to Yerevan. Trout could also be dried and carried far away for sale, joining this seemingly secluded mountain water to regional exchange.
simp_chinese: 塞凡湖占据亚美尼亚高地的一处高海拔湖盆，众多溪流注入湖中，赫拉兹丹河则由此流出。在现代工程降低水位之前，湖面海拔约1,916米，湖中有一座建着塞凡修道院的大岛。中世纪亚美尼亚作者称它为格加姆海，古典时代称吕克尼提斯，后来的突厥语名称格克恰则意为蓝色湖泊。它与凡湖、乌尔米耶湖一同被视为历史亚美尼亚的三大海。旅行者既留意湖滨宗教建筑，也关注其渔产。1673年，让·夏尔丹记述了清甜的湖水、岛上的修道院以及运往埃里温的鱼类。鳟鱼还可晒干后远运出售，将这片看似幽隔的高山湖水与区域交换连接起来。

english: Lake Shinji is a brackish coastal lagoon in Izumo. The Shimane Peninsula encloses it to the north, with the Izumo and Matsue plains on either side.
simp_chinese: 宍道湖是出云地区的一座半咸水滨海潟湖。北面受岛根半岛围绕，东西分别与出云平原、松江平原相接。

english: Shotozero belongs to the Olonets Karelian lake country. The wider region, inhabited by Karelians, came under Novgorodian rule in the twelfth century and later passed to Muscovy around 1478.
simp_chinese: 绍托泽罗湖属于奥洛涅茨卡累利阿湖区。整个地区有卡累利阿人居住，十二世纪受诺夫哥罗德统治，约1478年转入莫斯科控制。

english: The Wendat called this lake Ouentironk, or Beautiful Water, when Europeans first reached the region in the seventeenth century. Its northern narrows lead into Lake Couchiching and onward toward Georgian Bay, forming part of the route linking the interior waters with Lake Ontario. Indigenous fishers drove stakes into the narrows to create weirs; surviving timbers show that this practice extended back more than four thousand years. French traders later called the lake Lac aux Claies, the Lake of Grids, recalling those fishing structures. It also appeared as Lake Taronto on seventeenth-century maps, and the carrying route south helped convey that name to the future city of Toronto. In 1793 John Graves Simcoe renamed the lake in memory of his father, a Royal Navy captain, adding another name to a waterway already rich in human associations.
simp_chinese: 十七世纪欧洲人初到这一地区时，温达人称此湖为乌恩蒂龙克，意为“美丽的水”。湖泊北端的狭窄水道通往库奇钦湖，再向乔治亚湾延伸，构成内陆水域与安大略湖之间通路的一部分。原住民渔民在狭水道中打下木桩筑成鱼栅；留存木材表明，这种做法已有四千多年历史。法国商人后来称它为“格栅湖”，名称正是对这些捕鱼设施的记忆。十七世纪地图也曾标作塔龙托湖，向南的搬运路线又帮助这一名称传播到后来的多伦多城。1793年，约翰·格雷夫斯·锡姆科以自己身为英国海军舰长的父亲为湖泊改名，为这条早已积累众多人文联系的水道再添一个名字。

english: Lake Singkarak fills a deep tectonic basin in the Sumatran highlands between Tanah Datar and Solok. About twenty-one kilometres long, it lies roughly 362 metres above the sea and reaches a maximum depth of 268 metres. Its natural outlet is the Ombilin, which carries water eastward towards the Strait of Malacca. The lake is also home to the bilih, a small endemic fish caught for food. In much later times a hydroelectric scheme diverted most of the outflow westwards into the Anai and the Indian Ocean, changing an ancient drainage pattern in this mountain landscape.
simp_chinese: 辛卡拉克湖占据苏门答腊高地上一处深邃的构造盆地，位于丹那达达与索洛克之间。湖面长约二十一公里，海拔约362米，最大深度达268米。天然出水口翁比林河向东流去，最终汇向马六甲海峡。湖中还生活着当地特有的小型比利鱼，居民捕捞它作为食物。直到更晚的现代，水电工程才将大部分出流水改引向西，经过阿奈河注入印度洋，改变了这片山地延续已久的水系走向。

english:
Lake Skadar, also known as Scutari or Shkodra, occupies a broad karst basin beside the city of Shkoder. Its surface expands and contracts with the seasons, making it the largest lake in the Balkan Peninsula. The Moraca supplies most of its inflowing water, while the Buna, or Bojana, carries the outflow to the Adriatic.

Rocky, steep shores line the south and southwest, in contrast to the broad floodlands on the northern side. Springs rise beneath the lake itself, some from deep hollows known as oko. Small islands add human landmarks to this watery landscape: Beska has two churches, while Grmozur has served as both fortress and prison. Carp, bleak and eels inhabit the lake, and its wetlands shelter pelicans, herons and many other waterbirds.
simp_chinese:
斯卡达尔湖又称斯库台湖或斯科德拉湖，占据斯库台城旁一处宽广的喀斯特盆地。湖面随季节涨落，是巴尔干半岛最大的湖泊。莫拉查河提供了大部分入湖水量，布纳河，也称博亚纳河，则将湖水送往亚得里亚海。

南岸与西南岸多岩石陡坡，北岸则展开大片会随水位变化的泛滥地。湖底也有泉水涌出，其中一些位于称为oko的深凹地形中。小岛为这片水域增添了人文标记：贝什卡岛上有两座教堂，格尔莫茹尔岛则曾兼作堡垒和监狱。湖中生有鲤鱼、欧白鱼和鳗鲡，湿地则为鹈鹕、苍鹭及众多其他水鸟提供庇护。

english: Śniardwy spreads across the Masurian lake country, occupying a basin shaped by retreating ice. The broad, relatively shallow lake contains eight islands and was the largest lake of historical Prussia.
simp_chinese: 希尼亚尔德维湖铺展于马祖里湖区，湖盆由冰川消退塑造。这座宽阔而相对浅的湖泊有八座岛屿，曾是历史上普鲁士最大的湖泊。

english: Middle Kuyto Lake belongs to the broader Karelian country of northern Europe. The wider cultural region straddles Finland and northwestern Russia and preserves historical connections with both countries and Sweden.
simp_chinese: 中库伊托湖属于北欧更广阔的卡累利阿地区。这片文化区域跨越芬兰与俄罗斯西北部，保留着同两国及瑞典的历史联系。

english: Lake St. Clair forms a broad, shallow link in the Great Lakes waterway. Water from Lake Huron enters through the St. Clair River and its extensive delta, then leaves through the Detroit River toward Lake Erie. Indigenous peoples travelled this route long before French expeditions arrived; the Mississauga name Waawiyaataanong refers to a whirlpool. Archaeological finds near the eastern delta include bones and projectile points dating to roughly 1500–1000 BC, suggesting seasonal use of the shore. On 12 August 1679, La Salle’s expedition reached the lake and named it for Saint Clare of Assisi, whose feast fell that day. English maps later adopted the French name, with the spelling St. Clair appearing by 1755. Its modest depth, averaging only about eleven feet, distinguishes this crucial passage from the vast deeper lakes on either side.
simp_chinese: 圣克莱尔湖是五大湖水道上一处宽阔而浅的连接水域。休伦湖的来水经圣克莱尔河及其广大的三角洲流入湖中，再从底特律河流向伊利湖。法国探险者抵达之前，原住民早已沿这条水路通行；密西沙加人的湖名Waawiyaataanong含有漩涡之意。东部三角洲附近出土的骨骼与投射武器尖头可追溯至约公元前1500至1000年，显示人们曾季节性利用湖岸。1679年8月12日，拉萨尔探险队来到湖上，以当天纪念的阿西西圣嘉勒为湖命名。英国地图后来沿用了法文名称，到1755年已出现St. Clair的拼写。湖水平均仅约十一英尺深，使这条关键通道与两侧浩瀚而深邃的大湖形成鲜明差别。

english: Lake St Martin lies between Lake Manitoba and Lake Winnipeg. Water arrives through the Fairford River, Lake Manitoba’s only outlet, and leaves through the Dauphin River toward Lake Winnipeg, making the lake part of a connected prairie drainage system.
simp_chinese: 圣马丁湖位于马尼托巴湖与温尼伯湖之间。湖水经马尼托巴湖唯一出口费尔福德河流入，再沿多芬河流向温尼伯湖，使其成为相互连通的草原水系的一环。

english: Southwest of Munich, Lake Starnberg occupies a deep hollow carved by glaciers descending from the Alps. Its only outlet is the Würm, which gave the lake its older name, Würmsee; an early form of that name appears in a document of 818 and remained current under Emperor Louis the Bavarian. Bronze fish-hooks and a dugout from the ninth or eighth century before the common era reveal a much older history of life on its waters. The lake's close associations with the Wittelsbach dynasty also earned it the name 'Prince's Lake'. The modern name Starnberg became official only in 1962.
simp_chinese: 施塔恩贝格湖位于慕尼黑西南，占据着阿尔卑斯冰川挖出的深邃湖盆。唯一流出湖泊的维尔姆河，赋予了它旧名“维尔姆湖”；这一名称的早期形式见于818年的文书，并在皇帝巴伐利亚的路易统治时期继续使用。湖中发现的青铜鱼钩和公元前九世纪或八世纪的独木舟，展现出更古老的水上生活历史。由于与维特尔斯巴赫王朝联系密切，湖泊也获得了“亲王湖”的称呼。如今的施塔恩贝格湖之名，直到1962年才正式确立。

english: Lake Suğla lies in the Konya country of Anatolia, with water levels that fluctuate widely. Known as Trogitis in antiquity, it belonged to the ancient region of Lycaonia.
simp_chinese: 苏拉湖位于安纳托利亚科尼亚地区，水位变化很大。古称特罗吉蒂斯，属于古代吕考尼亚地区。

english: Lake Sulunga fills the closed Bahi depression west of Dodoma during wet years. Fed mainly by the Bubu and Mponde, the shallow seasonal basin can disappear in dry periods, while fishing and livestock raising support nearby settlements.
simp_chinese: 苏伦加湖在湿润年份填满多多马以西封闭的巴希洼地。主要由布布河和姆蓬德河补给，这片浅季节性湖盆在干旱时期甚至会消失，周边聚落则利用它捕鱼和畜牧。

english: Lake Sumozero belongs to the wider Zaonezhye setting north of Lake Onega. The larger region includes a peninsula and nearby islands, where the surrounding lake moderates the climate relative to much of Karelia.
simp_chinese: 苏莫泽罗湖处于奥涅加湖北面广义的外奥涅加地区。整个区域包括半岛与附近岛屿，周围湖水使其气候较卡累利阿大部分地区更温和。

english: Lake Suoyarvi feeds the Shuya River in Karelia. The river carries its waters to Lake Logmozero and onward through a short connecting watercourse to Lake Onega. Seasonal ice closes this broader river system during the long northern winter.
simp_chinese: 苏奥亚尔维湖补给卡累利阿舒亚河。河流将湖水输向洛格莫湖，再经短水道通往奥涅加湖。漫长北方冬季，季节性河冰封闭这套广义河川系统。

english: Lake Syamozero lies west of Petrozavodsk in Karelia and belongs to the Shuya–Onega drainage basin. Fishing, water transport and timber rafting have all made use of its island-dotted waters.
simp_chinese: 夏莫泽罗湖位于卡累利阿彼得罗扎沃茨克以西，属于舒亚河—奥涅加湖水系。人们利用岛屿散布的湖面捕鱼、运输及漂运木材。

english: Taal Lake fills a vast volcanic depression in southern Luzon, with an active volcanic island rising near its centre. Once known as Bombón, these waters formerly formed an inlet connected with Balayan Bay. Eruptions repeatedly reshaped both the shore and the settlements around it. In 1754 volcanic debris obstructed the Pansipit River, narrowing the outlet to the sea and raising the lake's level; towns including Taal, Lipa and Tanauan were rebuilt away from their former sites. Rainfall gradually transformed the enclosed salt water into fresh water. The lake's unusual animals preserve traces of this history, from freshwater-adapted trevally called maliputo to its endemic tawilis sardine.
simp_chinese: 塔尔湖位于吕宋岛南部，湖水充满一处巨大的火山凹地，湖心附近耸立着活火山岛。这片旧称邦邦的水域曾是与巴拉延湾相连的海湾。火山喷发反复改变岸线，也改变着周边聚落的命运。1754年，火山碎屑阻塞潘西皮特河，收窄通海出口并抬高水位；塔尔、利帕和塔纳万等城镇因此迁离旧址重建。降雨又逐渐将封闭水域中的咸水转变为淡水。湖中特殊的动物仍保存着这段演变的印记，包括适应淡水的鲹鱼“马利普托”，以及当地特有的塔维利斯沙丁鱼。

english: Lake Tana lies high in the Ethiopian Highlands and sends its waters into the Blue Nile. Its islands shelter monasteries that preserve royal burials and treasures of Ethiopian Christianity. Daga Estifanos holds the tombs of emperors including Yekuno Amlak, Dawit and Zara Yaqob, while other foundations range from fourteenth-century Debre Maryam to eighteenth-century Narga Selassie. Early visitors disagreed over how many islands the lake contained, partly reflecting its changing water level. Beyond the churches, the lake supports a distinctive community of fish, isolated from other waters by the Blue Nile Falls.
simp_chinese: 塔纳湖高居埃塞俄比亚高原，湖水流入青尼罗河。湖中岛屿上的修道院保存着皇室陵墓与埃塞俄比亚基督教的珍宝。达加斯蒂法诺斯修道院安葬着耶库诺·阿姆拉克、达维特和扎拉·雅各布等皇帝；其他寺院则包括十四世纪的德布雷马里亚姆与十八世纪的纳尔加塞拉西。早期访客对湖中岛屿的数量记载不一，部分反映了水位的变化。教堂之外，青尼罗河瀑布将湖泊与其他水域隔开，孕育了独特的鱼类群落。

english: Lake Tanganyika fills a long, mountain-walled trough in the western branch of the East African Rift. Stretching roughly 676 kilometres from north to south, it is the world's longest freshwater lake and, after Baikal, the deepest. Its three basins formed at different times and were separate lakes when water levels were lower. The Lukuga links its waters to the Congo system when the lake stands high enough to overflow. In the nineteenth century, after the early modern era, Swahili Arab traders connected Ujiji with Zanzibar through the caravan route from Bagamoyo and Tabora, and brought sailing dhows onto these inland waters.
simp_chinese: 坦噶尼喀湖占据东非大裂谷西支的一条狭长盆地，两侧山壁耸峙。湖泊南北绵延约676千米，是世界上最长的淡水湖，深度也仅次于贝加尔湖。三个湖盆形成于不同年代，水位较低时曾各自成为独立湖泊。当湖水高至能够溢流时，卢库加河将它与刚果河水系连接起来。进入19世纪、近代早期之后，斯瓦希里阿拉伯商人经巴加莫约与塔波拉的商队路线，将湖岸乌吉吉与桑给巴尔联系起来，并把三角帆船带到这片内陆水域。

english: Lake Tashk is a salt lake in Fars, east of Shiraz and close to Abadeh Tashk. Together with neighbouring Bakhtegan it forms a wetland landscape within a basin whose permanent rivers include the Kor and Sivand. Evaporation and saline waters strongly influence conditions, while groundwater supplies much of the basin's human demand for water. The lake's islands include Narges and Gonban. Its wetlands provide breeding and wintering grounds for water birds, including the marbled duck, making the basin a seasonal gathering place for migrants. In the much later era of formal conservation, Tashk and Bakhtegan were listed under the Ramsar Convention in 1975 and became a national park in 1995.
simp_chinese: 塔什克湖是法尔斯的一座咸水湖，位于设拉子以东，靠近阿巴德塔什克。它同邻近的巴赫特甘湖共同构成一片湿地景观，所在流域的常流河包括科尔河与西万德河。蒸发与咸水显著影响着这里的环境，而流域内人类用水则大量依靠地下水。湖中岛屿包括纳尔吉斯岛和贡班岛。湿地为包括云石斑鸭在内的水鸟提供繁殖与越冬场所，使湖盆成为候鸟季节性聚集之地。到了更晚的正式自然保护时代，塔什克湖与巴赫特甘湖于1975年列入《拉姆萨尔公约》名录，并在1995年成为国家公园。

english: Tasiujaq is a triangular inland bay on the eastern side of Hudson Bay, where river water mingles with the sea. Its steep western cliffs are breached by Le Goulet, a narrow tidal passage that remains open through winter. The Hudson's Bay Company established Fort Richmond off the southern shore in 1750, seeking to extend its trading presence along this coast. The scarcity of furs led to its closure in 1759. Known to European mapmakers by several changing names, including Sir Atwell's Lake and Richmond Gulf, the water retains an Inuit name meaning that it resembles a lake.
simp_chinese: 塔西尤阿克是哈得孙湾东岸一片三角形内湾，河水在这里与海水交汇。西岸陡峭的崖壁仅由勒古莱狭口贯通，潮水涌动使这条水道在冬季仍不封冻。哈得孙湾公司于1750年在南岸附近设立里士满堡，试图扩展沿海贸易据点。但当地毛皮稀少，商站于1759年关闭。欧洲制图者先后以阿特韦尔爵士湖、里士满湾等名称标记这片水域；如今沿用的因纽特语名称，意为形似湖泊之地。

english: Telmen is a saltwater lake in Mongolia’s Zavkhan Province. Its three islands and surrounding waters provide a gathering place for migratory birds.
simp_chinese: 特尔门湖是蒙古扎布汗省的一座咸水湖。湖中的三座岛屿及周围水域是候鸟聚集之地。

english: Lake Témiscamingue is a deep freshwater widening of the Ottawa River between Quebec and Ontario. Glaciers shaped its rocky basin, a remnant of ancient Lake Ojibway. Its Algonquin name evokes deep water and rapid winds; lake sturgeon, pike and trout inhabit its waters.
simp_chinese: 泰米斯卡明格湖是渥太华河在魁北克与安大略之间拓宽形成的深淡水湖。冰川塑造了岩石湖盆，它也是古奥吉布韦湖的残余。阿尔冈昆名称含深水与疾风之意，湖中生活着湖鲟、狗鱼和鳟鱼。

english: Lake Tempe lies in southern Sulawesi, west of Sengkang. Its broad waters form the largest lake in this southern part of the island, giving the surrounding lowland a distinctive inland water basin.
simp_chinese: 坦佩湖位于苏拉威西南部、森康以西。宽阔水面构成岛屿南部最大的湖泊，为周围低地增添了鲜明的内陆湖盆景观。

english: Lake Tengano occupies part of Rennell, a great raised coral atoll in the Solomon Islands. Known also as Tegano, it is the largest lake of the insular Pacific and forms part of a World Heritage landscape. Rennell’s inhabitants are of Polynesian descent, making the island an outlier within the mainly Melanesian archipelago.
simp_chinese: 滕加诺湖位于所罗门群岛的大型隆起珊瑚环礁伦内尔岛。它又称特加诺湖，是太平洋岛屿地区最大的湖泊，并构成世界遗产景观的一部分。伦内尔居民具有波利尼西亚血统，使此岛成为以美拉尼西亚人为主群岛中的文化飞地。

english: Terkhiin Tsagaan is a freshwater lake high in Mongolia's Khangai country, near the Khorgo volcano at its eastern end. Ten rivers enter it, while only the Suman River carries water away. Set more than two thousand metres above sea level, the lake gathers the waters of an upland landscape within a broad mountain setting. A local tale explains its origin through an uncapped spring: a sleeping boy allowed the water to spread, and his mother stopped it with the top of a mountain. In the story, the mountain fragment became the lake's small island. The tale gives a human form to the contrast between water, volcanic heights and isolated islands.
simp_chinese: 特尔欣查干湖是蒙古杭爱山区的高地淡水湖，东端附近矗立着霍尔戈火山。十条河流汇入湖中，却只有苏曼河将湖水带走。湖面海拔超过两千米，在群山之间汇集高地来水。地方传说以一眼未封住的泉水解释湖泊的起源：一个男孩睡着后，任由泉水漫延，母亲便用山顶堵住泉眼。故事中，那块山顶成为湖中的小岛。这则传说为湖水、火山高地与孤立岛屿之间的对照赋予了人的形象。

english: Lake Terreron lies in the wider lake country of the Nechako Plateau. This northern part of British Columbia’s Interior Plateau was built by lava over older rocks, then rounded into hills by great ice sheets. White spruce and subalpine fir grow across the region, sheltered from Pacific weather by the Coast and Hazelton mountains.
simp_chinese: 特雷龙湖位于内查科高原的广大湖区。这片不列颠哥伦比亚内陆高原北部的地貌，由覆盖古老岩层的熔岩形成，又经巨大冰盖雕琢成为起伏丘陵。白云杉与亚高山冷杉分布其间，海岸山脉与黑兹尔顿山脉阻挡了来自太平洋的天气系统。

english: Lake Tishkeozero belongs to the inland country of White Karelia. Across the wider Karelian region, lakes form a defining landscape, including Europe’s two largest, Ladoga and Onega.
simp_chinese: 季什克奥泽罗湖属于白卡累利阿内陆地区。在更广的卡累利阿，湖泊构成典型景观，包括欧洲最大的拉多加湖和奥涅加湖。

english:
High in northern Sumatra, Lake Toba fills an immense volcanic caldera roughly one hundred kilometres long. Its surface lies about nine hundred metres above the sea, and the water reaches depths of more than five hundred metres. The basin formed after a vast eruption around seventy-four thousand years ago; later uplift within the caldera raised the land that became Samosir Island.

Batak communities inhabit the shores, where traditional houses display brightly decorated roofs curving upwards at either end. The surrounding mountains carry rainforest and stands of Sumatran tropical pine. Despite its great size, the lake is poor in nutrients and supports a relatively limited native fish fauna, including the fish locally associated with the Batak name. Water, volcanic heights and distinctive settlements make this a landscape unlike Sumatra's low coastal plains.
simp_chinese:
多巴湖位于苏门答腊北部高地，湖水充满一座长约一百公里的巨大火山破火山口。湖面约在海拔九百米，最深处超过五百米。约七万四千年前的一次大喷发塑造了湖盆；其后火山口内部隆起，抬升出后来成为沙摩西岛的陆地。

巴塔克社群居住在湖滨，传统房屋装饰鲜艳，屋顶两端如船身般向上翘起。周围山地覆盖雨林，也分布着苏门答腊热带松林。湖泊虽大，水体却贫营养，原生鱼类相对有限，其中包括当地称作巴塔克鱼的种类。湖水、火山高地和独特聚落，共同构成迥异于苏门答腊低平海岸的景观。

english: Tolbo is a freshwater lake in western Mongolia south of Ölgii. It lies at about 2,080 metres above sea level, with open, treeless shores beside the route toward Khovd.
simp_chinese: 陶勒博湖是蒙古西部、乌列盖以南的一座淡水湖。湖面海拔约2080米，开阔无树的湖岸毗邻通向科布多的道路。

english: Lake Tondano lies about six hundred metres above the sea in northern Sulawesi, roughly thirty-six kilometres from Manado. It is the largest lake in this part of the island. Its waters shelter distinctive life found nowhere else, including the halfbeak fish Tondanichthys kottelati and the copepod Phyllodiaptomus sulawesensis. These endemic creatures make this inland body of water a separate ecological world within the broader landscape of Celebes.
simp_chinese: 通达诺湖坐落在苏拉威西北部海拔约六百米的高地，距万鸦老约三十六公里，是该岛北部最大的湖泊。湖中栖息着别处没有的独特生物，包括半嘴鱼 Tondanichthys kottelati 和桡足类 Phyllodiaptomus sulawesensis。这些特有物种使这片内陆水域，在西里伯斯广阔的地理景观中形成了独具特色的生态世界。

english: Topozero spreads across northern Karelia with more than a hundred islands. Fishing and timber rafting use its waters, while the Sofyanga carries its outflow towards Pyaozero and the wider Kovda system of the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 托波泽罗湖展开于卡累利阿北部，湖中有一百多座岛屿。当地利用湖水捕鱼与漂运木材，索菲扬加河则将湖水带往皮亚奥泽罗，并接入通向白海的科夫达水系。

english: Lake Towada fills a volcanic caldera in the mountains of northern Honshu. Two peninsulas project from its southern shore into deep blue water, and the Oirase River forms its only outlet towards the Pacific. Repeated eruptions shaped the basin over thousands of years; the last recorded eruption, in 915, sent ash across much of northeastern Japan and devastated nearby land with hot flows and mud. During the Heian and Kamakura periods the surrounding wilderness became a place of prayer and training for yamabushi. Worship of a water deity was linked with the legendary blue dragon believed to guard the lake. The region remained largely wild until late in the Edo period, when the Nambu rulers of Morioka undertook reclamation around Sanbongihara, drawing on the Oirase for irrigation. The lake's name is thought to derive from Ainu words meaning a rocky lake.
simp_chinese: 十和田湖占据着本州北部山地间的一座火山破火山口。两条半岛从南岸伸入深蓝色的湖水，奥入濑川则是通往太平洋的唯一出水河流。数千年间的反复喷发塑造了湖盆；最后一次有记录的喷发发生在915年，火山灰覆盖日本东北大片地区，灼热碎屑流与泥流重创了周围土地。平安和镰仓时代，湖畔荒野成为山伏祈祷与修行的场所，对水神的崇敬也与传说中守护湖泊的青龙相联系。直到江户时代后期，这一带仍大多保持荒野面貌；此后盛冈藩的南部氏在三本木原一带推动开垦，引奥入濑川水灌溉。湖名被认为源自意为“岩石之湖”的阿伊努语词汇。

english: Lake Towuti lies among the mountains of southern Sulawesi, its broad tectonic basin standing about 293 metres above the sea. It is the island's largest lake and belongs to the Malili system together with Matano and the smaller lakes Mahalona, Masapi and Lontoa. The Larona River carries its waters toward Boni Bay. This linked lake country shelters an exceptional variety of endemic life, including fishes, freshwater shrimps, crabs and snails. Towuti thus forms part of an inland aquatic world whose distinctiveness reaches far beyond the mountain shores visible to a traveller.
simp_chinese: 托武蒂湖位于苏拉威西南部群山之间，宽阔的构造湖盆海拔约293米。它是岛上最大的湖泊，与马塔诺湖及较小的马哈洛纳、马萨皮和隆托阿湖共同组成马利利湖群。拉罗纳河将湖水引向博尼湾。这片相连的湖区孕育着格外丰富的特有生物，包括鱼类、淡水虾、蟹与螺类。因此，托武蒂属于一个独特的内陆水生世界，其丰饶远超旅人眼中群山环绕的湖岸景色。

english:
Lake Trasimeno spreads across a shallow basin on the Umbrian border with Tuscany. Its muddy waters are rich in fish, while olive-covered hills, vineyards and small fortified towns surround the shore. With little inflow and no natural surface outlet, the lake is sensitive to changes in rainfall. Roman engineers cut a drainage tunnel near San Savino, and the work was restored during the Renaissance.

The northern shore witnessed the Battle of Lake Trasimene in June 217 BC, during the Second Punic War. The shoreline then reached farther north, leaving the exact battlefield uncertain. In later centuries the lake was contested by neighbouring powers including Perugia, Chiusi, Panicale and Florence. Isola Maggiore supported a fishing village that reached its height in the fourteenth century, alongside a Franciscan friary. The local tuoro method used wooden fish traps and encircling nets; its usefulness depended on high water, making the changing lake level a practical concern for fishermen as well as rulers.
simp_chinese:
特拉西梅诺湖铺展在翁布里亚与托斯卡纳交界的浅盆地中。浑浊的湖水富产鱼类，岸边则环绕着橄榄覆盖的丘陵、葡萄园与设防小镇。湖泊入水有限，也没有天然地表出口，因此对降雨变化十分敏感。罗马工程师曾在圣萨维诺附近开凿排水隧道，文艺复兴时期又加以修复。

公元前217年6月，第二次布匿战争中的特拉西梅诺湖战役发生在北岸。由于当时湖岸延伸得更靠北，战场的确切位置仍有不确定之处。后来的数世纪里，佩鲁贾、丘西、帕尼卡莱与佛罗伦萨等邻近势力争夺这片水域。马焦雷岛的渔村在十四世纪达到兴盛，岛上也设有方济各会修院。当地称为tuoro的捕鱼法以木制鱼陷和环绕的渔网作业，其效用依赖较高水位，使湖面涨落成为渔民与统治者共同面对的实际问题。

english: Trati Nam, also called Zhari Namco, is a salt lake on the Tibetan Plateau east of Coqen. It lies at about 4,613 metres above sea level and stretches over 54 kilometres. The lake spans the boundary country between Ngari’s Coqen and Ngamring in Shigatse.
simp_chinese: 扎日南木错是西藏高原上的咸水湖，位于措勤以东。湖面海拔约4613米，长逾54公里。湖区跨越阿里措勤与日喀则昂仁之间的地域。

english: Trichonida, known in antiquity as Trichonis, fills a basin in Aetolia beneath the Panaitoliko mountains to the north and northeast. It is Greece's largest natural lake, stretching about nineteen kilometres and reaching a depth of fifty-eight metres. Around a million years ago a much larger body of water covered ground that has since become the surrounding plain. Villages and farmland now border its shores, together with woods of maple and pine; the lake and its environs support more than two hundred species of birds.
simp_chinese: 特里霍尼达湖古称特里科尼斯，坐落在埃托利亚的一处湖盆中，北面与东北面耸立着帕奈托利科山。它是希腊最大的天然湖泊，长约十九公里，最深处达五十八米。约一百万年前，这里的湖面更为辽阔，曾覆盖如今已成为周边平原的土地。现在，村落与农田沿岸分布，其间有枫树和松树林；湖泊及周边地区栖息着二百多种鸟类。

english: Tulos is a large freshwater lake near the Finnish border in Karelia. Its island-dotted waters drain toward the Lieksanjoki and Lake Pielinen, while winter ice normally holds from November until May.
simp_chinese: 图洛斯是卡累利阿邻近芬兰边界的一座大型淡水湖。岛屿点缀的湖水流向列克萨河与皮耶利宁湖，冬季冰封通常从11月持续至翌年5月。

english: Lake Tungudskoye belongs to the inland country of White Karelia. The wider Karelian region extends between the White Sea and Gulf of Finland, forming a cultural borderland of historical importance to Russia, Finland and Sweden.
simp_chinese: 通古兹科耶湖属于白卡累利阿内陆地区。更广阔的卡累利阿延伸于白海与芬兰湾之间，是历史上对俄罗斯、芬兰和瑞典均有重要意义的文化边疆。

english:
Lake Turkana fills a long basin of the East African Rift amid hot, arid country. The Omo, Turkwel and Kerio rivers feed it, but no river carries its waters away: evaporation is its only outlet. This enclosed basin sustains the world's largest permanent desert lake, with alkaline waters, volcanic islands and shores that alternate between rocky outcrops and low dunes.

Its present isolation conceals a different past. During the early Holocene, higher waters overflowed toward the Nile, allowing fish and crocodiles to pass between the systems. Rich fossil deposits around the basin preserve a much deeper record of early human ancestors. For the peoples of its shores the lake also provides a living fishery; the Turkana name Anam Ka'alakol, "the sea of many fish", expresses that importance. Strong winds and sudden storms make its broad waters a demanding environment for those who venture onto them.
simp_chinese:
图尔卡纳湖占据东非大裂谷的一条狭长湖盆，四周炎热而干旱。奥莫河、图尔奎尔河和凯里奥河向湖中注水，却没有河流将湖水带走，蒸发是唯一的出路。这座封闭湖盆容纳着世界最大的永久性沙漠湖泊，碱性湖水之间分布着火山岛，沿岸则交替出现岩石露头与低矮沙丘。

今日的封闭状态掩盖着不同的过去。全新世早期，较高的湖水曾向尼罗河溢流，使鱼类与鳄鱼得以在两个水系之间迁移。湖盆周围丰富的化石层，保存着更为久远的早期人类祖先记录。对沿岸各族而言，湖泊也提供着现实的渔获；图尔卡纳语名称Anam Ka'alakol意为“多鱼之海”，表达了它的重要性。强风与突如其来的暴风，使这片宽阔水面对出湖者充满考验。

english: Lake Tuz occupies a closed depression on the central Anatolian plateau. Ancient writers knew it as Tatta, near the meeting of Lycaonia and Galatia, and remarked on the extraordinary salinity of its waters. Streams, groundwater and rainfall feed the basin, but no river carries its water away. In winter, incoming fresh water dissolves part of the accumulated salt; summer evaporation exposes a broad white crust. This annual cycle underlies salt extraction around the lake. Cultivated land borders much of the basin, while seasonally flooded salt-steppe spreads to the south and southwest, creating a sharp contrast between the fields and the pale, shallow inland water.
simp_chinese: 图兹湖位于安纳托利亚中部高原的一处封闭洼地。古代作家称其为塔塔湖，位于吕考尼亚与加拉太交接处附近，并记述了湖水异乎寻常的盐度。河流、地下水和降雨补充湖盆，却没有河流将湖水带走。冬季流入的淡水溶解部分积盐，夏季蒸发则使广阔的白色盐壳显露出来。这一年度循环构成了湖区采盐的基础。耕地环绕湖盆的大部分边缘，南部与西南部则展开季节性积水的盐生草原，使田野与浅淡的内陆湖水形成鲜明对照。

english: Tuzdysor is a closed salt lake northeast of Ekibastuz in Kazakhstan. It forms part of the wider Irtysh lake region, with Karasor to the southeast and Shandaksor to the southwest; commercial salt extraction has developed on its shores in recent times.
simp_chinese: 图兹德索尔是哈萨克斯坦埃基巴斯图兹东北的一座内流盐湖。它属于广阔额尔齐斯湖区的一部分，东南为卡拉索尔湖，西南为尚达克索尔湖；近年湖畔开展了商业采盐。

english: The Lake Tyers shore belongs to Australia’s eastern coastal region, which stretches across Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland and includes Tasmania offshore. This eastern part of the continent contains most of Australia’s population and its largest cities.
simp_chinese: 泰尔斯湖沿岸属于澳大利亚东部海岸区域，广义范围跨越维多利亚、新南威尔士和昆士兰，并包括近海的塔斯马尼亚。大陆东部集中了澳大利亚大部分人口及规模最大的城市。

english: Udyl is a broad freshwater lake near the Amur’s left bank. Despite its large surface, its greatest depth is only about five metres. It forms part of the lowland lake country of the lower Amur.
simp_chinese: 乌德利湖是黑龙江左岸附近的一片广阔淡水湖。湖面虽大，最大水深却只有约五米。它属于黑龙江下游低地的湖泊地区。

english: Ulaagchiin Khar is a lake in the Zavkhan country of Mongolia. It occupies a valley in the Khangai Mountains east of the Great Lakes Depression, with the Tovkhosh Mountains along its western shore.
simp_chinese: 乌拉格钦黑湖位于蒙古的扎布汗地区，占据大湖盆地以东杭爱山中的一处谷地，西岸为托夫霍什山脉。

english: Lake Ulansu belongs to the Hetao landscape around the northern bend of the Yellow River. Across this wider region, river floodplains lie beneath the Yin Mountains, with the Ordos desert country to the south and the Helan Mountains at the western margin.
simp_chinese: 乌兰苏湖属于黄河北部大弯环绕的河套地带。从更广区域看，河流冲积平原位于阴山之下，南侧是鄂尔多斯沙漠地区，西缘则为贺兰山。

english: Lake Ulgain belongs to the Shilingol country of Inner Mongolia. The wider region borders Mongolia to the north and preserves a strong pastoral and nomadic cultural presence alongside agricultural lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 乌尔盖湖属于内蒙古锡林郭勒地区。更广阔的区域北接蒙古，保留着深厚的游牧与畜牧文化，南部则与农业土地相邻。

english: Lake Uluabat, also known as Apolyont, spreads across a shallow basin near Bursa. The Mustafakemalpaşa River feeds it through a silty delta, and its waters reach the Sea of Marmara by way of the Susurluk system. Its older name recalls Apollonia-on-the-Rhyndacum, an ancient town whose position on important trade routes gave it regional significance. A Byzantine monastery survives on the island of Saint Constantine, while the surrounding country was long associated with silkworm cultivation. Extensive beds of white water lilies fringe the lake, and its marshy shores support fishing and rich colonies of waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 乌卢阿巴特湖又名阿波利翁特湖，在布尔萨附近的浅盆地中铺展开来。穆斯塔法凯末尔帕夏河经淤泥三角洲注入湖中，湖水再通过苏苏尔卢克水系流向马尔马拉海。湖泊的旧名让人想起林达库斯河畔的阿波罗尼亚古城；这座城因处于重要商路上而具有区域意义。圣君士坦丁岛上仍留有一座拜占庭修道院，周边地区则长期与养蚕业相联系。大片白色睡莲沿湖生长，沼泽般的湖岸支撑着渔业，也为众多水鸟提供栖息之地。

english: Lake Ulungur lies in northern Xinjiang, fed chiefly by the Ulungur River. Its larger Buluntuo basin and smaller Jili Lake are joined by a narrow channel, together forming a closed drainage system. Remarkably, the Irtysh flows towards the Arctic Ocean less than four kilometres away to the northeast, beyond the lake's own basin. Fisheries are an important use of these waters, and fishing continues through the winter ice. The closeness of two very different drainage systems later made a major intervention possible: a canal opened in 1987 diverted Irtysh water into Ulungur after decades of falling lake levels, helping the shore wetlands and fishery recover.
simp_chinese: 乌伦古湖位于新疆北部，主要由乌伦古河补给。较大的布伦托海与较小的吉力湖经狭窄水道相连，共同构成内流湖泊系统。颇为特别的是，向北冰洋流去的额尔齐斯河就在东北不足四公里之外，却属于湖盆以外的另一水系。渔业是这片水域的重要用途，冬季冰封后仍进行冰上捕鱼。两套截然不同的水系相距如此之近，后来使大型引水工程成为可能：1987年开通的渠道将额尔齐斯河水引入乌伦古湖，缓解此前数十年湖面下降，并帮助岸边湿地与渔业恢复。

english: Umbozero lies between the Khibiny Mountains and the Lovozero uplands on the Kola Peninsula. Its broad basin contains deep hollows reaching more than a hundred metres below the surface. The lake freezes in late October, and Sarvanovsky is its largest island.
simp_chinese: 温博泽罗湖位于科拉半岛希比内山与洛沃泽罗高地之间。宽广湖盆内的深洼超过水面以下一百米。湖泊在十月下旬结冰，萨尔瓦诺夫斯基是其中最大的岛屿。

english: Lake Upemba lies within the broad Upemba Depression in the southern Congo basin. Nearby Lake Kisale belongs to the same lowland landscape, while floating islands form a distinctive feature of Upemba itself.
simp_chinese: 乌彭巴湖位于刚果盆地南部广阔的乌彭巴洼地。附近基萨莱湖属于同一低地景观，漂浮岛屿则是乌彭巴湖自身的一项独特景象。

english: Lake Urmia occupies a closed basin in the Azerbaijani lands of northwestern Iran, separating the country around Urmia from the routes toward Tabriz. Rivers carry water into it, but none carries it away: evaporation leaves a strongly saline lake. The Zarrineh and Simineh provide a substantial share of its inflow. Its shores belong to a landscape of very ancient settlement, with sites such as Yanik Tepe, Hasanlu and Dalma Tepe preserving successive prehistoric communities. Shahi, historically the largest island, is associated with the burials of the Ilkhans Hülegü and Abaqa. Amid salt water and scattered islands, brine shrimp sustain migratory birds including flamingos. The lake's changing shoreline has long made water, land and island boundaries a shifting element of the region's geography.
simp_chinese: 奥鲁米耶湖位于伊朗西北部阿塞拜疆地区的一处封闭盆地，将奥鲁米耶周边土地与通向大不里士的路线分隔开来。河流将水送入湖中，却没有河流将水带走；蒸发使湖水高度咸化。扎林河与西米内河提供了相当大的一部分入湖水量。湖岸拥有极为古老的聚落历史，亚尼克丘、哈桑鲁与达尔马丘等遗址保存着前后相继的史前社群痕迹。历史上最大的沙希岛，则与伊儿汗旭烈兀和阿八哈的安葬联系在一起。盐水与散布的岛屿之间，卤虫供养着包括火烈鸟在内的候鸟。不断变动的岸线，使水面、陆地和岛屿的边界一直成为当地地理中流动的一部分。

english: Lake Urru lies high on the Tibetan Plateau between Nyima and Xainza. Several rivers feed it, while an eastward outlet towards Jargö Lake places it within the wider Siling Lake drainage system.
simp_chinese: 吴如错高踞西藏高原，位于尼玛与申扎之间。多条河流注入湖泊，湖水向东流往恰规错，使其成为色林错水系的一部分。
